                             NOTES

                             It is common for pets to be tired, lethargic, or sore for 12-24 hours after receiving a vaccine. More serious vaccine
                             reactions are uncommon; signs to watch for include swelling of the face or neck, difficulty breathing, a severe
                             lethargy. Sometimes a serious reaction may begin with mild signs like hives, and progress to more serious
                             symptoms. If you see these more serious signs, immediately contact or go to a veterinarian.
